argv: import json,collections; d=json.load(open('tools/registry.json', encoding='utf-8')); rows=d['rows']; print('rows', len(rows)); print('status', dict(collections.Counter(r.get('status') for r in rows))); print('kind', dict(collections.Counter(r.get('kind') for r in rows))); print('active', len([r for r in rows if r.get('status')=='active'])); print('external', [r['name'] for r in rows if r.get('external') is True]); print('new-r24', [r['name'] for r in rows if 'new-r24' in r.get('tags',[])]); print('new-r21', [r['name'] for r in rows if 'new-r21' in r.get('tags',[])]); print('active-new-r26', [r['name'] for r in rows if 'new-r26' in r.get('tags',[]) and r.get('status')=='active']); print('superseded', [(r['name'], r.get('superseded_by')) for r in rows if r.get('status')=='superseded'])
